# Butterbox pull request checklist

## Scope and verification

- What this PR changes: Hides the entire onboarding section at 5/5, while preserving it for incomplete progress. Uses the active business’s owner-authorized server state; missing or failed data produces an error state, not completion.
- Related GitHub issue (ordinary link or issue number, if applicable): Refs #82
- Acceptance criteria passed / blocked: Added executable coverage for incomplete combinations, completion, regression, errors, owner-only access, and business-specific states. Browser coverage for final-step completion, tenant switching, and employee access is added but not run.
- Tests actually run and their outcomes: Focused onboarding tests passed (7/7); TypeScript check, E2E syntax check, diff check passed; CodeQL reported no alerts.
- Known blockers and deferred checks: Browser E2E and ESLint were not run because `node_modules` is absent.
- Documentation: updated `/docs/USER_GUIDE.md`.

## Issue closure

Use normal GitHub issue links for traceability. Special HTML issue/evidence
markers and attempt-specific JSON/Markdown attachments are not required for the
Verify workflow.

GitHub may automatically close an issue when closing keywords such as
`Fixes #N` are used and the pull request merges into the default branch.
Prefer `Refs #N` for partial work. Check the issue acceptance criteria before
intentionally closing it. Wording alone must not cause CI to fail.

Keep all required code, database, security, review and branch-protection checks.
